data.one_liner: A VLC-powered video player alternative for Flutter, supporting multiple players.
data.what_it_does: Provides a VLC-powered widget and controller for playing audio and video streams or files on Android and iOS. Supports multiple players on a single screen and features like video recording and external display casting.
use_when: You need a robust video player with extensive format support via VLC.
You need to display multiple video players simultaneously on one screen.
Flutter's default video_player lacks necessary features or format support.
avoid_when: You need web or desktop support (the package supports Android and iOS only).
You want a lightweight alternative and the full libVLC binary footprint is too large for your app.
strengths: Supports multiple players on a single screen.
Works fully on iOS simulators, unlike Flutter's default video_player.
Built-in video recording and chromecast external display support.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (Android and iOS only).
Video recording has known issues if the video reaches its end while recording.
Requires manual configuration for network security policies and permissions on Android and iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform configuration: internet/storage permissions and cleartext traffic flags on Android, and AppTransportSecurity or local network/Bonjour keys on iOS.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want the official Flutter team's video player plugin using native platform primitives.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: You need a feature-rich, highly customizable audio player rather than a video player.
